h:
这是我个人工作流程的最新进展。我喜欢在不使用大量洛拉的情况下设计角色。

此工作流程旨在为图像提示提供稳定性，同时使其模块化以对角色的各个部分进行更改。提示被分成单独的部分，然后进行加权和连接。这允许您仅更改提示的一部分（例如角色的服装），而不更改整个提示。

此工作流程确实使用一个 lora 来控制场景的照明。

o.en:
This is the latest evolution in my personal workflow. I like designing characters without using a lot of loras.

This workflow is designed to be used to provide stability to the image prompt while making it modular to make changes to individual parts of a character. The prompt is broken out into individual pieces that are then weighted and concatenated. This allows you to change only a portion of the prompt like the character's outfit, without changing the whole prompt.

This workflow does use one lora to control the lighting of the scene.
